definitions.short: Eliel , the name of nine Israelites
definitions.full: H447. Eliel אֱלִיאֵל proper name, masculine ( El is God , or my God is God ) only Chronicles a. two or three of David's chiefs 1Chr 11:46-47 , 12:11 . b. chief of Manasseh 1Chr 5:24 . c. two chiefs of Benjamin 1Chr 8:20 , 22 . d. chief of the Hebronites 1Chr 15:9 , 11 . e. a chief Kohathite 1Chr 6:19 = אֱלִיאָב v. 6:12 compare אֱלִיהוּ 1Sam 1:1 . feminine a Levite 2Chr 31:13 .
